class_list.description:
Generates the list of style classes for a [style setting](https://shopify.dev/storefronts/themes/architecture/settings/style-settings) or a collection of settings.

Developer preview

Style settings are currently only available as part of the Theme blocks developer preview.

#### Example ```liquid {{ settings.layout | class_list }} ``` --- [Shopify Liquid](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/liquid/filters/class_list) Last Updated: 2nd February 2025

inline_asset_content.description:
Outputs the content of an asset inline in the template. The asset must be either a SVG, JS, or CSS file. 

**Note**

> The asset size must be less than 15KB to be inlined.
>

#### Example

```liquid

{{ 'icon.svg' | inline_asset_content }}

```

---

[Shopify Liquid](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/liquid/filters/inline_asset_content)


Last Updated: 2nd February 2025

avatar.description:
Generates HTML to render a customer's avatar, if available. 

**Tip**

> Use with the [`customer.has_avatar?`](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/liquid/objects/customer#customer-has_avatar?) method to determine if the customer has an avatar.

```liquid
{{ customer | avatar }}
```

---

[Shopify Liquid](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/liquid/filters/avatar)


Last Updated: 2nd February 2025

structured_data.description:
Converts an object into a schema.org structured data format. The `structured_data` filter can be used on the [`product`](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/liquid/objects/product) and [`article`](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/liquid/objects/article) objects.

Product objects are output as a [schema.org `Product`](https://schema.org/Product) if they have no variants, and a [`ProductGroup`](https://schema.org/ProductGroup) if they have one or more variants.

Article objects are output as a [schema.org `Article`.](https://schema.org/Article)

#### Example

```liquid

<script type="application/ld+json">
  {{ product | structured_data }}
</script>

```

---

[Shopify Liquid](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/liquid/filters/structured_data)


Last Updated: 2nd February 2025
